en_title: Video Game Spending Dropped 14 Percent This October, Possibly Because Everyone Was Preparing for GTA 6
cn_title: 今年10月电子游戏支出下降14%，可能是因为所有人都在为《GTA6》做准备
opus_summary: Circana报告显示，尽管《使命召唤：现代战争4》和《战争机器：事变日》于10月发售，当月电子游戏支出仍同比下降14%。报告指出，移动端支出下滑及去年《战地风云6》的强劲销量是主要因素。Take-Two首席执行官认为，《GTA6》即将发售也可能影响了消费者支出。

paragraphs.en: The amount of money that players spent on video games this October fell 14%, and it’s little surprise that this coincided with the release of GTA 6 in November.
paragraphs.cn: 今年10月，玩家在电子游戏上的支出下降了14%；这一情况恰逢《GTA6》于11月发售，也就不足为奇了。

paragraphs.en: A new report from market research firm Circana shows that gamers were a bit more frugal this October than they were last year, despite two major games releasing that month. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launched on October 23, and Gears of War: E-Day released on October 1. Both games enjoyed reasonable critical reception, though reviews for Modern Warfare 4 were rather mixed .
paragraphs.cn: 市场研究公司Circana的一份新报告显示，尽管有两款大作在今年10月发售，玩家在这个月还是比去年同期节俭了一些。《使命召唤：现代战争4》于10月23日推出，《战争机器：事变日》则于10月1日发售。两款游戏的媒体评价都还不错，不过《使命召唤：现代战争4》收到的评论褒贬不一。

paragraphs.en: It’s worth noting that sales for E-Day paled in comparison to the rave reviews it received, with analysts estimating that the game only sold 400,000 copies across both console and PC as of October 30. And last October, Battlefield 6 rocked players’ wallets as one of the best-selling games in the entire series — and, indeed, the best-selling game of the entire year — so it’s not a head-scratcher that this was a tough act for MW4 and E-Day to follow.
paragraphs.cn: 值得注意的是，与《战争机器：事变日》收获的好评如潮相比，它的销量相形见绌；分析师估计，截至10月30日，该游戏在主机和PC平台的总销量仅为40万份。而去年10月，《战地风云6》作为整个系列最畅销的游戏之一——实际上也是全年最畅销的游戏——让玩家的钱包大出血，因此《使命召唤：现代战争4》和《战争机器：事变日》难以企及这一成绩，也就不难理解了。

paragraphs.en: Circana’s report found that consumer spending on console, specifically, fell 18% from last year, and compared this trend to sales from Battlefield 6 and Pokémon Legends: Z-A . The report pointed to a 16% decline in mobile spending as the primary driver of this drop in addition to Battlefield's booming sales from last October.
paragraphs.cn: Circana的报告发现，具体而言，消费者在主机上的支出较去年下降了18%，并将这一趋势与《战地风云6》和《宝可梦Legends: Z-A》的销量进行了比较。报告指出，除了《战地风云》去年10月的火爆销量外，移动端支出下降16%是此次下滑的主要推动因素。

paragraphs.en: However, it’s hard to ignore the impact that GTA 6 has had on the industry at large. Earlier this month, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick revealed that the release of the world’s most highly anticipated game likely had an impact on the lower-than-expected sales for NBA 2K27, as well as other titles.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，《GTA6》对整个行业造成的影响难以忽视。本月早些时候，Take-Two首席执行官Strauss Zelnick透露，这款全球最受期待的游戏的发售，很可能对《NBA 2K27》及其他游戏低于预期的销量产生了影响。

paragraphs.en: “I do think that this timing may have affected performance so far,” he told IGN in an exclusive interview . “It has been a crowded period, and we do think that GTA 6 coming has had an influence on the consumer. That said, we're thrilled with how NBA 2K27 is performing.”
paragraphs.cn: 他在接受IGN独家采访时表示：「我确实认为，这个时间点可能影响了迄今的表现。这段时期有很多游戏推出，我们也确实认为《GTA6》的到来对消费者产生了影响。尽管如此，我们对《NBA 2K27》的表现感到非常高兴。」

paragraphs.en: The launch of GTA 6 has proven to be a massive and unprecedented moment in pop culture history, to the point where analysts saw a 17% increase in time off requests for its release date on November 19. Even world governments were hopping on the bandwagon, with Australia’s workplace regulator reminding employees of their rights to PTO in a viral post last month. Germany also boasts a program that allows workers to take time off for professional development to play the game.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》的推出已被证明是流行文化史上一个规模空前的重大时刻，分析师甚至发现，针对其11月19日发售日的休假申请增加了17%。就连世界各国政府也加入了这股热潮：澳大利亚的职场监管机构上个月在一则广泛传播的帖子中提醒雇员享有带薪休假权利。德国也有一项计划，允许劳动者为了职业发展而休假游玩这款游戏。

paragraphs.en: If that wasn’t wild enough, a U.S. Army Battalion even advertised a special reenlistment incentive that gave service members four days of paid leave that directly coincided with GTA 6’s release, which 43 soldiers ended up taking . It remains to be seen if GTA 6 will really save the average gamer $5,000 by staying indoors, but so many people have hopped online to play that internet service providers reported a massive spike in traffic from Xbox consoles.
paragraphs.cn: 如果这还不够疯狂，美国陆军的一个营甚至宣传了一项特殊的续役奖励，让军人在正好赶上《GTA6》发售的时间享有四天带薪假期，最终有43名士兵选择了这项奖励。《GTA6》是否真的能让普通玩家通过待在家里省下5000美元，还有待观察；但上线游玩的人数如此之多，以至于互联网服务提供商报告称，来自XBOX主机的流量出现了大幅激增。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA6》，或者不知道接下来该做什么？来看看IGN上的《GTA6》官方指南。如果你还在摸索，可以通过新手指南——67条提示与技巧了解《侠盗猎车手》的新系统，或者通过第一章指南与提示和第二章指南与提示了解前几章的全部细节。如果你已经开车游遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现和进行的内容，就来看看Leonida互动地图。
